Original English: I do not want to cancel my order.
Original Urdu: میں اپنا آرڈر منسوخ نہیں کرنا چاہتا ۔
Meaning comparison: Removing not reverses the cancellation preference; dropping I/my loses ownership.

Original English: She is not going to school.
Original Urdu: Kon sa school ja raha hai
Meaning comparison: The original output is unreliable Roman Urdu (Kon sa school ja raha hai) and omits negation. The reduced output means going to school; stop-word removal also loses negation and subject. This example exposes translator noise as well as preprocessing damage.

Original English: He gave the book to her.
Meaning comparison: Removing he/to/her loses the giver, recipient and transfer direction.
